extraction: Complete functions/methods (including decorators and attributes) or complete small scripts. CRLF normalized to LF and final line breaks omitted before recording original_excerpt_sha256. Comments and Python docstrings removed using syntax-node byte ranges in removed_spans, relative to the original normalized excerpt. Comment/docstring-only lines removed; trailing spaces on affected lines and outer blank lines trimmed. Inline removals leave a space only when needed to keep adjacent tokens separated. All remaining code and string literals retained. Source URLs and line ranges refer to the original excerpt; excerpt_sha256 hashes the cleaned typing text.
